fato_historico: 2009: Maurice Clemmons shoots and kills four police officers inside a coffee shop in Lakewood, Washington.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you embrace a gentle perspective today. While the world may experience shadows, remember that light always finds a way to return. Consider how your unique spirit can foster peace in your immediate surroundings. It is a good time to nurture your inner harmony and let your kindness shine brighter than any fleeting darkness.
frase_do_dia: Kindness is the lighthouse that guides us safely through every stormy night.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual intuition and the path towards collective enlightenment.
conselho: Practice mindful listening and offer warmth to those who cross your path today.
